purpose: Bind the existing F-WP-007 epoch/fence/expiry lease primitive to owner-lane packet execution so foreground chats, Second Shift, and system automations cannot concurrently hold mutation authority for the same owner lane.
laws: At most one unexpired mutation-capable owner-lane claim may exist for an owner_path at a time.
A second claimant MUST fail closed while the current owner-lane claim is live; implicit preemption is forbidden.
The same holder renews through the exact current epoch and fence token; reacquisition is not renewal.
An expired claim may be replaced through a new F-WP-007 lease epoch; the old fence MUST remain stale.
Foreground Chat and Second Shift are peer execution modes for exclusion purposes: neither may displace the other's live mutation claim.
Read-only inspection does not require a mutation lease and MUST NOT create one.
Every mutation authorization MUST match owner_path, canonical_branch, current_packet, executor_id, executor_mode, epoch, fence token, and the exact current branch head.
A branch-head mismatch MUST fail closed before mutation; reconciliation is required before a new write authorization.
A current_packet mismatch MUST fail closed; a lease for one packet does not authorize its successor.
After an authorized repository mutation, the holder may advance expected_head_sha only from the exact previously authorized head to the observed resulting head.
Release MUST require the exact holder identity, executor mode, epoch, and fence token.
A successor packet requires release or an explicit governed transition; mutation authority does not silently roll forward to a new packet.
The owner-lane lease grants execution exclusivity only. It does not grant product, semantic, manuscript, canon, admission, publication, A-01, or human authority.
The durable adoption layer MUST use compare-and-swap semantics for the shared claim record so two external executors cannot both successfully acquire the same owner lane from one prior state.

durable_adoption_requirement.target: GitHub-backed owner-lane claim registry with compare-and-swap update, plus mandatory foreground-chat and Second-Shift admission checks

non_claims: This contract does not modify or supersede the qualified F-WP-007 generic lease primitive.
This contract does not itself provide durable cross-chat or cross-process storage.
This contract does not grant Second Shift authority over a foreground-owned packet or vice versa.
This contract does not alter Book, Prose, Story Bible, Research, Documents, Learning, or author semantic authority.
No A-01 target qualification is inferred from hosted qualification of this binding.
